propositions: A committed lock file freezes transitive dependencies, causing any newly-published advisory against a pinned version to block all in-flight changes via pip-audit gating, regardless of code changes
The pip-audit retry logic only handles DB-unreachable failures, not real advisory findings, so operators cannot recheck a legitimate advisory discovery
Using constraint-dependencies to work around an upstream cap is ineffective because it only narrows constraints; override-dependencies must be used instead to replace the offending requirement
An override of an upstream dependency cap is only safe when the cap is stale rather than representing a real incompatibility, and this requires external evidence before application
No runbook or discoverable guidance exists to help responders distinguish real findings from transient failures and correctly apply the right resolution technique under time pressure
